_meta.name: views
_meta.what: How an element is shown, by its kind. Presentation data, not the standard. A kind with no row draws as its type draws today, in the standard's section order. Each tool keeps its own drawing and reads the row; nothing here says who may see or do what (that is the server's, by what it serves).
_meta.match: A row's kind is a type alone, a type with a supertype, or a profile's pair, which matches only with that profile's mark, by that profile's own reader (room: isRoomElement in npm, is_room_element in Python; charter: isCharterElement, is_charter_element). Types and supertypes are trimmed and folded as profiles/room.md defines once. The most specific row wins: a profile's pair, then a type with a supertype, then a type alone. No two rows hold the same kind: a file where two do is at fault. An element no row matches has no row and draws as its type; the banners still show.
_meta.sentence: The card's, a list row's and a hover's one sentence: the first field named in the row's `sentence` whose value is a string that holds something after trimming; that value trimmed, cut at its first line break (U+000A or U+000D), and trimmed again, whitespace being the room profile's White_Space set. A field whose value is not a string holds nothing. No field holds anything: no sentence.
_meta.banners: Marks a served body carries, shown at the head of every kind's page in this order, each read as the page or document named defines it: `hidden` and `known_of` only when true, `x_served_trimmed` only when it names a field, and the two review marks only when the value is an object with something in it (profiles/review.md rules 1 and 4: an empty mark is settled, and a reader that shows a world to its people ignores a value that is not an object). A row's own `banner` adds to them, after them. Three of them are onlyworlds.com's own, not the standard's, and say so: a reader on another platform may never see them.

banners.defined_by: onlyworlds.com, not the standard: a known-of stub, known_of: true (the API document, https://www.onlyworlds.com/api/v2/openapi.json)
onlyworlds.com, not the standard: hidden: true, served only to readers who still see the element (the API document, https://www.onlyworlds.com/api/v2/openapi.json)
onlyworlds.com, not the standard: ids the server left out of a list, the field named (the API document, https://www.onlyworlds.com/api/v2/openapi.json; profiles/message.md reads it)

layouts.document: the fields in the row's order: lead open, then the rest in the standard's sections, then fold; a kind with no row is a document
layouts.conversation: the element within its chain by the named link, oldest first by created_at, stopping at an id already visited
